About

Honest dealing, careful hands

A. Jordan Watches was built on two things: a genuine passion for fine watchmaking, and a straightforward way of doing business. Whether you're selling a watch that's sat in a drawer for years or need a trusted pair of hands to keep your daily wear running true, we treat every piece as if it were our own.

Based in Southampton and working with clients across the UK, we combine careful, hands-on servicing with fair, transparent valuations — no hard sell, no jargon, just straight answers.
